headline: Messiah leads the MACC in scoring and defense
dek: Messiah has eighteen wins against two losses and three draws this season, pairing 72 goals scored with nine conceded. That attacking output exceeds York (Pa.) and Eastern (Pa.) combined, leaving Messiah still playing into December after the rest of the conference has finished.
